g.text: Immediate retrieval effects at paired checkpoint targets
n = 42,000 blocks; fixed equal ALL_F/ALL_M mixture. Intervals jointly ≥95% under the protocol’s
independent-uniform-word idealization. Dotted lines: ± material threshold δ. F is unconditional.
